map.估算旅行拍摄所需的存储卡空间: Estimate the memory card space needed for shooting while travelling
map.所需存储 = 照片占用 + 视频占用；照片占用 = 天数 × 每日张数 × 单张: Required storage = photo usage + video usage. Photo usage = days × shots per day × average size per file (phone about 4 MB, APS-C about 12 MB, full frame about 25 MB, RAW about 40 to 60 MB). Video usage = days × minutes shot per day × size per minute (1080p about 130 MB/min, 4K about 350 MB/min). Recommended capacity = required × 1.3 to leave headroom, converted at 1000 MB = 1 GB.
map.📚 深度解析：旅行照片存储估算: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Travel Photo Storage Estimation
map.手机 7 天每天 200 张: Phone, 7 Days at 200 Photos per Day
map.phone[3,5]MB 均值 4，照片 1400×4=5600MB；加 4k3: phone[3,5]MB average 4 gives photos 1400×4 = 5600MB; adding 4k30 video at 30min × 400MB × 7 = 84000MB; total ≈ 89600MB ≈ 87.5GB, so a 128GB card is recommended.
map.fullframe[20,35]MB 均值 27.5，同 1400 张≈3850: fullframe[20,35]MB average 27.5 gives about 38500MB for the same 1400 shots; RAW is counted on top, so the card needs to be larger.
